notes: Quotes are now costed rather than guessed. Each option carries its crew, and the app shows what it costs you, what you clear and the margin, and prices it at your target in one press. Settings hold your crew, editor and kit rates. Quotes state the crew on the night, carry an add-on list and a discount for booking a whole run at once with the deposit up front, and say plainly that prices are preliminary while venues and times are unconfirmed. Tick "they booked the whole run together" and that discount carries into the confirmation, the deposit and the invoice.
